targets.name: Swift Run
targets.archive_interpretation: Sandstone with varied detrital grains; the report interprets part of its matrix as Fe-Mg carbonate.
targets.planning_question: Do grain sizes and bedding vary between this sandstone and the nearby finer-grained site?
proposed_observations: Photograph bedding with scale and orientation.
Record exposed grain sizes and distinguish loose material from in-place rock.
Compare with Hazeltop; do not infer mineral identity from color.
targets.proposal_origin: MarsFlex author-designed comparative investigation; not a NASA EVA task or science-value ranking
limitations: Report coordinates identify historical sampling locations, not guaranteed accessible astronaut workspaces.
Observations at an existing sample site do not establish that nearby terrain has the same properties.
The proposed visit is a planning scenario, not permission to alter a cached sample or historical site.

targets.name: Hazeltop
targets.archive_interpretation: Fine-grained sedimentary rock interpreted as sulfate-bearing mudstone, with calcium-sulfate-rich veins.
targets.planning_question: Are veins and fine-grained textures spatially associated, suggesting alteration after deposition?
proposed_observations: Map visible veins relative to bedding without disturbing the sampled surface.
Collect scaled close-up photographs of texture changes.
Compare with Swift Run and the lower-sulfate interpretation at Shuyak.
targets.proposal_origin: MarsFlex author-designed comparative investigation; not a NASA EVA task or science-value ranking
limitations: Report coordinates identify historical sampling locations, not guaranteed accessible astronaut workspaces.

targets.name: Shuyak
targets.archive_interpretation: Fine-grained sedimentary rock interpreted as olivine-bearing mudstone with aqueous alteration and little sulfate evidence.
targets.planning_question: Does this site show a different alteration pattern from the sulfate-bearing Hazeltop site?
proposed_observations: Document grain texture and visible veins with scale.
Treat mineralogical differences as archive interpretations requiring appropriate instrumental follow-up.

selection_policy: Three deliberately selected historical sites for a texture/alteration comparison. Not an exhaustive inventory or science-value ranking.
